pages.title: Eternity Catalyst
pages.text: Time flows through it without passing. A closed timelike curve keeps it forever at the same moment, and the cosmological constant keeps its space from collapsing. It is required by the final processes and never consumed by them. It feels neither old nor new.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Reality Compiler, I fused a Spacetime Catalyst with a Closed Timelike Curve, a Bootstrap Artifact and the Cosmological Constant, sealed with Causal Solder. Time inside stopped moving, but did not stop.
Made in $(item)Reality Compiler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Simulation Hypothesis.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Unified Notes II.
